scope: Focused frontend text, palette and continuous-scroll correction; no backend/research code, schema, model or benchmark changes.

canvas.subtitle: Adaptive RAG Benchmarking & Optimization
canvas.method: Licensed original SSR document retained intact; allowlisted headline text/ink, title and background substitutions only.
canvas.verification: Actual Canvas fillText calls recorded; no demo strings in rendered srcDoc; reverse substitutions exactly reproduce original document SHA-256. Actual hover/hold Canvas frame changes verified.

scroll.root: One hero and one existing Studio on the same native scroll page
scroll.entry: #workspace; native smooth scroll, immediate for Skip/reduced motion
scroll.reveal: Overlapping rounded inset mask expands to full width; no pinning or wheel prevention
scroll.state: Single Studio DOM instance retained during forward/reverse scrolling
scroll.sidebar: Sticky embedded desktop sidebar with native scroll chaining; existing mobile drawer
scroll.resources: Canvas iframe absent when hero is offscreen and restored on reverse scroll

checks.method: Initial unaffected navigation/API cases plus final focused Canvas/scroll/palette reruns; real mobile touch scroll separately verified. No claim of one clean all-case run.
checks.automated_wcag_aa: PASS for reduced-motion continuous page on all three sizes
checks.native_browser: Customized Canvas inspected; normal down/up scrolling revealed the real workspace at unchanged root URL; iframe removal/restoration observed.
checks.routes: Root plus all eleven existing workspace routes; direct Overview, Back, sidebar, Enter Workspace, Pipeline Tour and real API reconnect checked.
checks.costly_ml_benchmarks: NOT RUN; unnecessary for this frontend-only correction

limitations: Safari/Firefox and physical trackpad hardware not separately tested; Chromium wheel, keyboard and genuine touch inputs verified.
No research data was reconstructed or invented.
